matches.rationale: Ground truth concerns fabricated references [7, 37] in the Introduction about fairness and safety surveys. No finding addresses citation fabrication or references [7, 37]; pred_id 4 and 9 concern different citation errors ([13] and [2]).

Both identify the same contradiction in LayerCast's method description: ground truth notes confusion about whether upcasting happens 'just in time' or globally; pred_id 5 documents the direct contradiction between 'without upcasting to FP32 at runtime' versus 'all computations occur in full FP32 precision' in Section 4.

Ground truth concerns unrealistic 0% Std@Acc claims for LayerCast in Appendix Table 26. Pred_id 10 addresses a different LayerCast table discrepancy (factor-10 error in BF16 Std@Acc), not the perfect reproducibility claim issue.

Both address OOM asymmetry in Qwen3-32B FP32 experiments. Ground truth notes FP32 cannot be loaded in some configurations (9 of 12 feasible); pred_id 11 identifies contradiction between text claiming 4-GPU OOM and Table 10 showing successful 4-GPU loads.

Ground truth concerns the Abstract's narrow attribution of variability solely to floating-point non-associativity, ignoring other GPU-level sources. No finding addresses this claim or the Abstract's causal attribution.

Ground truth concerns hyperbolic language in the Conclusion about LayerCast achieving 'FP32-level determinism while maintaining reasonable memory efficiency.' No finding addresses rhetorical overselling or the Conclusion section.
Ground truth concerns omission of environmental/energy cost discussion in the Appendix's societal impacts section. No finding addresses ethical omissions or environmental considerations.

Ground truth identifies contradiction between Introduction's assertion that fixed seeds ensure determinism and empirical evidence of nondeterminism in greedy decoding. No finding addresses this specific Introduction-level logical inconsistency about seed determinism.

Ground truth concerns cherry-picking or excluding BF16 catastrophic failure data points in variance tables. No finding identifies missing or excluded data points; findings address computational errors in reported values, not data selection bias.

Ground truth concerns oversimplified claim that BF16 variance is mostly due to fewer mantissa bits, ignoring model architecture interactions. No finding addresses this interpretive oversimplification or the mantissa-bits explanation.

Ground truth concerns lack of motivation for sample sizes (4, 16, 64 runs) and missing confidence intervals in random sampling experiments. No finding addresses experimental sample size justification or statistical testing omissions.

Ground truth concerns unclear relationship between random seed control and numerical precision effects in Preliminaries Section 2. No finding addresses this conceptual confusion about determinism definitions in greedy decoding.

Ground truth concerns overstated language in Introduction claiming numerical nondeterminism 'poses a serious problem' without acknowledging mitigation strategies. No finding addresses rhetorical overstatement or practical impact claims in the Introduction.

Ground truth identifies unexplained contradiction where Table 5 shows FP32 variance occasionally exceeding BF16 (AIME'24, n=64), contradicting the paper's general FP32-stability narrative. No finding addresses this specific FP32 > BF16 anomaly or its lack of explanation.

Ground truth concerns omission of limitations discussion (model size, architecture, hardware diversity) in Appendix Section A. No finding addresses missing limitations or generalization scope omissions.
Ground truth concerns Figure 1 caption incorrectly quoting 480 vs 960 rhombi (doubling the error to exaggerate instability). No finding addresses Figure 1 or the rhombi example accuracy values.

Ground truth concerns use of subtly different random seeds across greedy decoding runs, undermining attribution of variance to numerical effects. No finding addresses random seed protocol inconsistencies in experimental setup.

Ground truth concerns Related Work section's overgeneralization that prior studies 'fully failed' to recognize numerical precision impacts. No finding addresses the Related Work section or misrepresentation of prior literature.

Ground truth identifies contradiction between Preliminaries Table 1 showing similar BF16/FP16 rounding errors (~-0.00012) and experiments showing markedly different output variance. No finding addresses this cross-section inconsistency between Table 1 rounding errors and empirical variance results.

Ground truth concerns missing LayerCast implementation details (non-linear layers, normalization, activation treatment) impairing reproducibility. No finding addresses missing implementation details or reproducibility protocol gaps for LayerCast.
